verdict: Google Business Profile engagement dropped sharply; paid channels remain inactive.
narrative: Across all three locations — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — your Google Business Profile listings were the sole source of customer engagement this period, combining for 349 total actions (directions, web clicks, and calls). That activity dropped steeply in the final week, with all three locations recording zero GBP actions for four consecutive days (Sep 6–9), a confirmed collapse that is being investigated for a listing or local-search visibility issue. Paid advertising (Meta and Google Ads) generated no spend or leads across any entity this period. In parallel, several milestones due August 31 — including contact list pulls needed to start outreach and a web/SEO root-cause filing — are overdue and are being resolved now to unlock the next phase of pipeline activity. The priority this week is restoring GBP visibility and clearing those blockers so outreach sequences and SEO recovery can begin before the end of September.
